_about: Where flh_handbook_build fetches Image-Line's FL Studio manual on the user's PC. Nothing from these pages ships with fl-headless. 'latest' is the current online manual. by_major: archived manuals for older FL versions (e.g. "21": "https://.../") - add only URLs you have opened and confirmed (the build checks robots.txt and fetches Index_Frame_Left.html under that base). delay_s: pause between page requests (robots.txt crawl-delay wins if larger).
